set: A: one sheet across each of the ten beats, with no time and no word on it

issues.where: every frame, the ball on the office playfield
issues.what: the arrow is a few pixels inside a ball seen from overhead. It shows no pose, no feeling and no reaction to any bumper hit for the whole sheet, so it reads as a plain pinball, not a character
issues.fix: cut in a close-up or punch-in on two or three of the hits so the arrow reacts (jolts, flinches, spins inside the ball), or scale the ball up and give the arrow a clear tilt or recoil on each hit

issues.where: every frame, overhead and angled table shots
issues.what: same as A-05: the arrow is too small to read and does not react to the flippers or the spinner. The beat plays as pinball footage with no acting in it
issues.fix: give at least one held reaction close-up (exhausted droop or dizzy wobble) and make the arrow's orientation in the ball change clearly on each impact

issues.where: rows 1 and 4 overhead frames; row 2-3 ramp close-ups
issues.what: in the ramp and spinner close-ups the arrow stays upright and rigid in the same pose, sliding along like a pointer behind glass. There is no reaction to the Background Check scrutiny
issues.fix: in the spinner close-up, have the arrow spin or wobble with the ball and come out tilted and off-balance, then hold that dizzy pose for a few frames

issues.where: row 1 frame 3 to row 2 frame 3, the plunger close-up
issues.what: there is no wind-up before the launch. The arrow holds the same neutral pose across four frames, then is gone. It does not brace, crouch or look up the lane
issues.fix: before the plunger fires, have it lean back and compress (a slight squash of the arrow inside the ball), then stretch along the lane direction as it shoots off

issues.where: rows 2-4 close-up in the You're Fired kicker
issues.what: the dread is readable but the arrow stays rigid while caught and when it is kicked out. It does not squash on the hit or recoil when ejected, and the ejection frame is a blur with no reaction pose
issues.fix: add a squash or flinch the moment the kicker catches it, a small shiver while it is held, and a clear startled stretch on the kick-out

issues.where: all impacts with bumpers and flippers (e.g. row 3 frame 2 on the flippers)
issues.what: there is no squash on landing or impact and no stretch at speed anywhere on the table sheets. Ball and arrow stay perfectly rigid
issues.fix: add a few frames of ball and arrow deformation on contact, or at least a sharp angle snap of the arrow inside the ball on each hit

issues.what: the arrow is not on screen for the whole beat, so the sheet carries no acting and no reaction to landing in the machine
issues.fix: include a beat of the ball landing at the plunger with the arrow reacting (looking around, shrinking back) as the table lights come on

issues.what: the arrow's reaction to the copies appearing is only a small orientation change at tiny size, and is not held long enough to read as surprise
issues.fix: punch in when the copies spawn and hold a clear startled pose (arrow stretched upward, jerked back) for several frames

issues.where: row 2 frame 3 (empty vent) to row 3 frame 1 (arrow on Continue)
issues.what: the arrow jumps from the vent to the Continue button with no in-between, so the weary walk to the button is lost
issues.fix: add frames of the arrow trudging from the vent to the button, slow and drooping, before the click

issues.where: row 2 frames 1-3, the approach to the vent
issues.what: the pull toward the vent has only a faint tilt and no clear moment where it notices the danger and resists
issues.fix: add a held beat where it stops and leans away from the vent before it is yanked in, with a stretch toward the vent as it goes

issues.what: did not read: the wait in the lane and the firing are read; that the arrow inside the ball realizes what the plunger is about to do is not: it is read as passive, with no clear feeling, just carried.
issues.fix: The realizing as a held pose of its own before the plunger lets go: the arrow seen large enough in the ball to be read, a look down at the plunger, a brace, then the launch.

issues.what: did not read: the hope at the open doors and being shut out are read; that the doors slam, the ball hits them and the arrow is pressed flat against the inside of the glass is not: the read ends with it turned away, disappointed.
issues.fix: The slam and the flattening seen close: the doors closing in one or two frames, the ball on them, the arrow flat on the inside of the glass and held there before it slides back.

issues.what: did not read: the rattling between the bumpers is read; that the arrow is thrown flat inside the ball on each hit is not: the read is of a small ball being battered with no readable feeling.
issues.fix: Each hit answered by the arrow in the ball: thrown against the far wall and flat for a few frames, at a size in the picture at which it can be seen.

issues.what: did not read: the read is of a worn out ball bounced between flippers and a spinner. The fall toward the gap, the flipper catching it at the last instant and the arrow sagging with relief are not in the read.
issues.fix: The fall toward the gap as its own moment, the catch at the last instant, and the sag of relief held inside the ball in the slow motion the beat has.

issues.what: did not read: the drain, the way out of the outlet, the dazed arrow and the press on Continue are read. The result card saying it passed, the peel off the page and the shake are not; and the page turn is read as a zoom out that shows the page as part of another machine.
issues.fix: The result card readable as a pass before the arrow moves; the peel and the shake as actions of their own; and a page turn that reads as a page turning (the stage's, the Builder's).

reads.read: calm, idle pointer drifting on the form page; it lifts, gets pulled toward the round vent, tips over as it is sucked in, is sealed in a clear ball and dropped down the tube toward a machine below; surprised and helpless
no readable feeling, the arrow is not visible; the pinball table it was dropped into lights up around it, something is about to happen to it
waiting in the plunger lane, then fired up the lane at speed and thrown around the table; passive, no clear feeling, just carried
bounced around the Corporate HQ level, then hopeful as it rolls up to the HQ doors, then shut out and turned away, dropping down to the lower office level; disappointed
knocked around between bumpers and flippers on the office level (Pizza Party in lieu of raises); no readable feeling, it is a small ball being battered
Reply All: grey copies of the ball flood the table; the arrow seems startled and pushed around among them, then drains to the lower level
drops into the Entry-Level table, hits the You're Fired target and is caught in the red kicker; dread while it sits trapped, then kicked out
Unpaid Overtime: flipped about, sent up a ramp and through the Background Check spinner; carried along, faintly uneasy, no clear reaction
Multiple Hats: worn out, bounced back and forth between flippers and the spinner with no clear reaction

drains off the table and is spat back out of the vent on the form page, tilted and dazed, then wearily clicks Continue; the zoom-out shows the page is part of another machine, so it is about to go round again
